title: WorkerEvent
description: One SSE event from GET /jobs/{id}/events. Events are ordered, append-only, reconnectable via seq, and redacted.

event_id.description: Stable event identifier; identical across replays.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per job; reconnect cursors use Last-Event-ID / from_seq.

payload.description: Redacted progress/result metadata. Must not contain secrets, raw LLM responses, or user vault content.

error.description: Structured error block for job.failed events.
